name: mawaeidi-mobile
description: Mawaeidi mobile app for Android and iOS with synchronized lesson schedules and platform-specific reminders

scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test:students: node students/tests/student-registry.test.cjs && node students/tests/production-integration.test.cjs && node students/tests/workspace.test.cjs && node tests/full-backup.test.cjs && node students/tests/student-trash.test.cjs && node tests/unified-trash.test.cjs && node students/tests/student-summary.test.cjs && node tests/world-clock-sync.test.cjs && npm run test:native
scripts.ios:project: npm run mobile:prepare && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false @capacitor/ios@8.5.2 && npx cap add ios --packagemanager SPM && node scripts/prepare-ios-project.mjs && ruby scripts/register-ios-plugin.rb
scripts.ios:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/prepare-ios-project.mjs && ruby scripts/register-ios-plugin.rb
